title: Bride Price Controversy
synopsis: The payment of a “bride price” on marriage remains a deeply ingrained custom across China.

fullText.simplified:
彩礼风波

    最近几年，工作不如以前好找，生活成本增加了。在大城市工作不再是年轻人们毕业后的第一选择。毕业生们会根据自己的实际需求决定去哪儿工作，做什么工作。
    张明就是个比较明智的大学毕业生。他大学毕业以后回了老家，一个中国北方的四线城市。通过家人的帮助，他在当地找到了一份不错的工作，再加上张明自己聪明努力，很快就升职加薪了。
    工作稳定了，就该考虑个人问题了。张明的亲戚朋友们开始给他介绍女朋友。这不，不到半年的时间，张明就已经见了八九个女孩儿了。他对其中一个女孩儿印象不错，女孩儿也觉得张明的条件不错。目前，他们俩已经交往三个多月了。
    双方家长看到两个孩子相处得不错，就约了个时间，找了个饭店打算聊聊孩子们订婚的事情。没想到的是，这次的见面不但没有锦上添花，反而还让张明和女孩儿分了手。分手的原因竟然是因为彩礼。原来张明老家男女结婚，女方要的彩礼比较高。虽然这是个常见的问题，但是对张明这样的在大城市上过学的人来说，他认为过高的彩礼是一种陋习，两个人结婚是因为爱情，并不是为了赚钱。所以当女方父母提出高彩礼要求时，张明直接打断了他们的话，说出了自己的想法：“结婚该花的钱我们一分不会少，房子、车子什么的，别人结婚有的我们都会有。适当的彩礼也是应该的，但是20多万的彩礼确实有点过分了。我不同意也不愿意再让家里出更多的钱。”女方觉得行就订婚，不行的话，趁现在感情还不深，就算了吧，别耽误彼此。女孩儿觉得张明连彩礼都不愿意出，是不重视自己；女方父母觉得张明没礼貌，居然敢顶撞长辈。就这样两家人不欢而散。
    彩礼可以说是中国传统文化中比较重要的部分。因为彩礼代表的不仅仅是金钱，更重要的是一份心意。对中国很多百姓而言，彩礼也象征着好彩头。结婚给“彩礼”一般是男方给女方父母一笔钱。它表达了男方真心娶女方的态度，同时也是对女方父母养育女儿的答谢。但后来这种风俗变了味，很多地区“彩礼”成了攀比甚至是赚钱的工具。
    最新的网络统计信息显示，中国彩礼最高的几个省份分别是：福建省、江苏省、浙江省、甘肃省和河南省，其中福建省个别地区彩礼竟然高达50万。面对高昂的“彩礼”，不少单身小伙子表示：“天哪！还是单身吧！一人吃饱全家不饿，起码没有那么大的压力。”
    还有一个有趣的现象是，“天价彩礼”常常出现在小城市和偏远地区，这可能和当地经济与教育发展不够有关。不过，随着社会的发展和人们教育水平的提高，越来越多的年轻人正在改变他们的想法，而且他们也试图通过自己的努力劝说家人改变过去的老传统。相信今后彩礼将慢慢不再是困扰更多年轻男性的难题，大家也都能真正找到爱情。
fullText.traditional:
彩禮風波

    最近幾年，工作不如以前好找，生活成本增加了。在大城市工作不再是年輕人們畢業後的第一選擇。畢業生們會根據自己的實際需求決定去哪兒工作，做什麼工作。
    張明就是個比較明智的大學畢業生。他大學畢業以後回了老家，一個中國北方的四線城市。通過家人的幫助，他在當地找到了一份不錯的工作，再加上張明自己聰明努力，很快就升職加薪了。
    工作穩定了，就該考慮個人問題了。張明的親戚朋友們開始給他介紹女朋友。這不，不到半年的時間，張明就已經見了八九個女孩兒了。他對其中一個女孩兒印象不錯，女孩兒也覺得張明的條件不錯。目前，他們倆已經交往三個多月了。
    雙方家長看到兩個孩子相處得不錯，就約了個時間，找了個飯店打算聊聊孩子們訂婚的事情。沒想到的是，這次的見面不但沒有錦上添花，反而還讓張明和女孩兒分了手。分手的原因竟然是因為彩禮。原來張明老家男女結婚，女方要的彩禮比較高。雖然這是個常見的問題，但是對張明這樣的在大城市上過學的人來說，他認為過高的彩禮是一種陋習，兩個人結婚是因為愛情，並不是為了賺錢。所以當女方父母提出高彩禮要求時，張明直接打斷了他們的話，說出了自己的想法：“結婚該花的錢我們一分不會少，房子、車子甚麼的，別人結婚有的我們都會有。適當的彩禮也是應該的，但是20多萬的彩禮確實有點過分了。我不同意也不願意再讓家裡出更多的錢。”女方覺得行就訂婚，不行的話，趁現在感情還不深，就算了吧，別耽誤彼此。女孩兒覺得張明連彩禮都不願意出，是不重視自己；女方父母覺得張明沒禮貌，居然敢頂撞長輩。就這樣兩家人不歡而散。
    彩禮可以說是中國傳統文化中比較重要的部分。因為彩禮代表的不僅僅是金錢，更重要的是一份心意。對中國很多百姓而言，彩禮也象徵著好彩頭。結婚給“彩禮”一般是男方給女方父母一筆錢。它表達了男方真心娶女方的態度，同時也是對女方父母養育女兒的答謝。但後來這種風俗變了味，很多地區“彩禮”成了攀比甚至是賺錢的工具。
    最新的網絡統計信息顯示，中國彩禮最高的幾個省份分別是：福建省、江蘇省、浙江省、甘肅省和河南省，其中福建省個別地區彩禮竟然高達50萬。面對高昂的“彩禮”，不少單身小伙子表示：“天哪！還是單身吧！一人吃飽全家不餓，起碼沒有那麼大的壓力。”
    還有一個有趣的現象是，“天價彩禮”常常出現在小城市和偏遠地區，這可能和當地經濟與教育發展不夠有關。不過，隨著社會的發展和人們教育水平的提高，越來越多的年輕人正在改變他們的想法，而且他們也試圖通過自己的努力勸說家人改變過去的老傳統。相信今後彩禮將慢慢不再是困擾更多年輕男性的難題，大家也都能真正找到愛情。

sentences.simplified: 对中国很多百姓而言，彩礼也象征着好彩头。
sentences.traditional: 對中國很多百姓而言，彩禮也象徵著好彩頭。
sentences.pinyin: duì zhōng guó hěn duō bǎi xìng ér yán cǎi lǐ yě xiàng zhēng zhe hǎo cǎi tóu
sentences.english: Because the bride price represents not just money but, more importantly, sincerity.

sentences.simplified: 结婚给“彩礼”一般是男方给女方父母一笔钱。
sentences.traditional: 結婚給“彩禮”一般是男方給女方父母一筆錢。
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn gěi cǎi lǐ yì bān shì nán fāng gěi nǚ fāng fù mǔ yì bǐ qián
sentences.english: For many people in China, the bride price also symbolizes good fortune.

sentences.simplified: 它表达了男方真心娶女方的态度，
sentences.traditional: 它表達了男方真心娶女方的態度，
sentences.pinyin: tā biǎo dá le nán fāng zhēn xīn qǔ nǚ fāng de tài du
sentences.english: Usually, in a marriage, the “bride price’” is a sum of money given by the groom to the bride’s parents.

sentences.simplified: 同时也是对女方父母养育女儿的答谢。
sentences.traditional: 同時也是對女方父母養育女兒的答謝。
sentences.pinyin: tóng shí yě shì duì nǚ fāng fù mǔ yǎng yù nǚ ér de dá xiè
sentences.english: It expresses the groom’s sincere attitude towards marrying the bride, ..

sentences.simplified: 但后来这种风俗变了味，
sentences.traditional: 但後來這種風俗變了味，
sentences.pinyin: dàn hòu lái zhè zhǒng fēng sú biàn le wèi
sentences.english: .. and it is also a token of appreciation to the bride’s parents for raising their daughter.

sentences.simplified: 很多地区“彩礼”成了攀比甚至是赚钱的工具。
sentences.traditional: 很多地區“彩禮”成了攀比甚至是賺錢的工具。
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō dì qū cǎi lǐ chéng le pān bǐ shèn zhì shì zhuàn qián de gōng jù
sentences.english: But later on, this custom deviated from its true purpose.
In many places, the “bride price” became a means of competing or even a way to make money.

sentences.simplified: 最新的网络统计信息显示，中国彩礼最高的几个省份分别是：
sentences.traditional: 最新的網絡統計信息顯示，中國彩禮最高的幾個省份分別是：
sentences.pinyin: zuì xīn de wǎng luò tǒng jì xìn xī xiǎn shì zhōng guó cǎi lǐ zuì gāo de jǐ ge shěng fèn fēn bié shì

sentences.simplified: 福建省、江苏省、浙江省、甘肃省和河南省，
sentences.traditional: 福建省、江蘇省、浙江省、甘肅省和河南省，
sentences.pinyin: fú jiàn shěng jiāng sū shěng zhè jiāng shěng gān sù shěng hé hé nán shěng
sentences.english: The latest online statistics show that the provinces with the highest bride prices in China are ..

sentences.simplified: 其中福建省个别地区彩礼竟然高达50万。
sentences.traditional: 其中福建省個別地區彩禮竟然高達50萬。
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng fú jiàn shěng gè bié dì qū cǎi lǐ jìng rán gāo dá 2 wàn
sentences.english: .. Fujian Province, Jiangsu Province, Zhejiang Province, Gansu Province, and Henan Province.

sentences.simplified: 面对高昂的“彩礼”，不少单身小伙子表示：
sentences.traditional: 面對高昂的“彩禮”，不少單身小伙子表示：
sentences.pinyin: miàn duì gāo áng de cǎi lǐ bù shǎo dān shēn xiǎo huǒ zi biǎo shì
sentences.english: In some regions of Fujian Province, the bride price can even be as much as 500,000 RMB.

sentences.simplified: “天哪！还是单身吧！一人吃饱全家不饿，起码没有那么大的压力。”
sentences.traditional: “天哪！還是單身吧！一人吃飽全家不餓，起碼沒有那麼大的壓力。”
sentences.pinyin: tiān na hái shi dān shēn ba yì rén chī bǎo quán jiā bú è qǐ mǎ méi yǒu nà me dà de yā lì
sentences.english: Faced with a high “bride price”, many young single men say, ..
.. “My goodness! It’s better to stay single! With only one mouth to feed, at the very least, there is not so much pressure.”

sentences.simplified: 还有一个有趣的现象是，“天价彩礼”常常出现在小城市和偏远地区，
sentences.traditional: 還有一個有趣的現象是，“天價彩禮”常常出現在小城市和偏遠地區，
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yí ge yǒu qù de xiàn xiàng shì tiān jià cǎi lǐ cháng cháng chū xiàn zài xiǎo chéng shì hé piān yuǎn dì qū

sentences.simplified: 这可能和当地经济与教育发展不够有关。
sentences.traditional: 這可能和當地經濟與教育發展不夠有關。
sentences.pinyin: zhè kě néng hé dāng dì jīng jì yǔ jiào yù fā zhǎn bú gòu yǒu guān
sentences.english: Another interesting phenomenon is that “sky-high bride prices” often appear in small cities and remote areas, ..

sentences.simplified: 不过，随着社会的发展和人们教育水平的提高，
sentences.traditional: 不過，隨著社會的發展和人們教育水平的提高，
sentences.pinyin: bú guò suí zhe shè huì de fā zhǎn hé rén men jiào yù shuǐ píng de tí gāo
sentences.english: .. which may be related to the lack of local economic and educational development in these areas.

sentences.simplified: 越来越多的年轻人正在改变他们的想法，
sentences.traditional: 越來越多的年輕人正在改變他們的想法，
sentences.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de nián qīng rén zhèng zài gǎi biàn tā men de xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: However, with the development of society and the improvement of people’s educational level, ..

sentences.simplified: 而且他们也试图通过自己的努力劝说家人改变过去的老传统。
sentences.traditional: 而且他們也試圖通過自己的努力勸說家人改變過去的老傳統。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě tā men yě shì tú tōng guò zì jǐ de nǔ lì quàn shuō jiā rén gǎi biàn guò qu de lǎo chuán tǒng
sentences.english: .. more and more young people are changing their thinking.

sentences.simplified: 相信今后彩礼将慢慢不再是困扰更多年轻男性的难题，
sentences.traditional: 相信今後彩禮將慢慢不再是困擾更多年輕男性的難題，
sentences.pinyin: xiāng xìn jīn hòu cǎi lǐ jiāng màn man bú zài shì kùn rǎo gèng duō nián qīng nán xìng de nán tí
sentences.english: Moreover, they are also trying to persuade their families to change old traditions through their own efforts.

sentences.simplified: 大家也都能真正找到爱情。
sentences.traditional: 大家也都能真正找到愛情。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā yě dōu néng zhēn zhèng zhǎo dào ài qíng
sentences.english: We believe that in the future, the bride price will slowly cease to be a problem for more young men, ..

sentence_translations: Bride Price Controversy
In the last few years, jobs have not been as easy to find as before, and the cost of living has increased.
Working in a big city is no longer the first choice for young people after graduation.
Graduates will decide where to work and what job to do based on their actual needs.
Zhang Ming was a relatively sensible college graduate.
He returned to his hometown after graduating from college, which is a fourth-tier city in northern China.
With the help of his family, he found a good job in the local area.
On top of that, Zhang Ming was smart and hardworking, and he soon got a promotion and a raise.
With a stable job, it was now time to consider personal matters.
Zhang Ming’s relatives and friends began to introduce him to potential girlfriends.
As a matter of fact, in less than half a year, Zhang Ming had met eight or nine girls.
He had a good impression of one of the girls, and the girl also considered Zhang Ming to be a desirable partner.
They had been dating for more than three months.
Both sets of parents saw that the two of them got along well.
So they set a time and found a restaurant to discuss their children’s engagement.
Unexpectedly, this meeting didn’t turn out to be the icing on the cake, ..
.. on the contrary, it actually made Zhang Ming and the girl break up.
The reason for the breakup was actually because of the bride price.
It turns out that when people get married in Zhang Ming’s hometown, the bride price demanded by the bride’s family is relatively high.
Although this is a common issue, for someone like Zhang Ming, who has studied in a big city, ..
.. he believes that an excessively high bride price is a bad custom.
People marry for love, not to make money.
So when the bride’s parents asked for a high bride price, Zhang Ming immediately interrupted them and told them what he thought:
“We will spend no less than what we should to get married, get a house, a car, and so on.
We’ll have everything that people getting married have.
An appropriate bride price is also a must, but a bride price of more than 200,000 RMB really is a little excessive.
I don’t agree with that, and I’m not willing to let my family pay more money.
If the bride’s side had agreed, they would have gotten engaged.
If they didn’t agree, they should part ways while their feelings were still not deep and not waste each other’s time.
The girl felt that since Zhang Ming was not even willing to pay the bride price, he did not value her.
The girl’s parents felt that Zhang Ming had no manners, daring to contradict his elders.
Just like that, the two families parted on bad terms.
The bride price is arguably one of the more important parts of traditional Chinese culture.
Because the bride price represents not just money but, more importantly, sincerity.
For many people in China, the bride price also symbolizes good fortune.
Usually, in a marriage, the “bride price’” is a sum of money given by the groom to the bride’s parents.
It expresses the groom’s sincere attitude towards marrying the bride, ..
.. and it is also a token of appreciation to the bride’s parents for raising their daughter.
But later on, this custom deviated from its true purpose.
In many places, the “bride price” became a means of competing or even a way to make money.
The latest online statistics show that the provinces with the highest bride prices in China are ..
.. Fujian Province, Jiangsu Province, Zhejiang Province, Gansu Province, and Henan Province.
In some regions of Fujian Province, the bride price can even be as much as 500,000 RMB.
Faced with a high “bride price”, many young single men say, ..
.. “My goodness! It’s better to stay single! With only one mouth to feed, at the very least, there is not so much pressure.”
Another interesting phenomenon is that “sky-high bride prices” often appear in small cities and remote areas, ..
.. which may be related to the lack of local economic and educational development in these areas.
However, with the development of society and the improvement of people’s educational level, ..
.. more and more young people are changing their thinking.
Moreover, they are also trying to persuade their families to change old traditions through their own efforts.
We believe that in the future, the bride price will slowly cease to be a problem for more young men, ..
.. and everyone will be able to truly find love.
